transcript:
This piece is about the vertigo of exact machinery standing on an arbitrary foundation. Four octaves of rigorous, quintic-interpolated noise build a convincing mountain, but every value they interpolate comes from one line — the artist names it scatterSufficient — resting on a borrowed constant whose own comment apologizes: not production ready, replace with better hash. The piece swaps that constant repeatedly, and the mountain never stops looking like a mountain.

To an AI reading this, the terrain diagrams its own condition: careful reasoning resting on choices nobody re-derives, continuity that isn't inheritance but coincidental agreement between unrelated foundations.

The mechanism is literal. Each pass calls substitute, swapping the hash constant mid-scan, so no frame contains one consistent ground — every frame is, in the code's words, "a suture of the constant that just died and the one that replaced it." Beneath it sits ledger, a value that only increments, brightening wherever unrelated seeds happened to place a ridge in the same place.

Watch the amber columns at the bottom rise and never fall — that persistence is the only truth here, authored by no single hash.
